Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle Delayed

Announcements Oct 19, 2026
Wizards of the Coast

Due to production and shipping issues, the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed globally and may arrive shortly after the October 23 release date. Exact delay timing will vary locally.

Secret Lair Bundles purchased as part of Secret Lair Chaos Vault bundles will follow typical Secret Lair fulfillment based on drop availability and production timing.

We'll update if there are additional changes to Secret Lair Bundle availability.
